title: From faint patterns to galaxies
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Small early density differences grew under gravity over cosmic time. This growth contributed to the large-scale distribution of galaxies and clusters observed today.

misconception: A learner may choose: They guaranteed galaxies were present at the CMB epoch
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: How are early density differences related to the cosmic web?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: How are early density differences related to the cosmic web? Gravity helped small differences grow into larger structures. Small early density differences grew under gravity over cosmic time. This growth contributed to the large-scale distribution of galaxies and clusters observed today.
Visual caption: Small differences can grow. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.
